issue.title: test_cli_history.py hardcodes literal date '2026-08-24' as expected 'today', breaking after that date
issue.description:
`tests/test_bead/test_cli_history.py::test_history_full_makes_overwritten_note_revisions_readable`
asserts `"from: [2026-08-24" in output` (line 226). That literal is the wall-clock date
on which the test was last touched, not a computed value. `_revision_chain()` calls
`BeadProject.create(...)` with no injected clock, so the bead's creation event is
stamped with the real current UTC date, and the history renderer echoes that date back
in the `from:` field of the next revision. The assertion therefore only holds while
"today" happens to equal the hardcoded string, and silently breaks the moment the wall
clock rolls past it.

Found while running `just test-cost` for an unrelated plan
(`disabled_region_launch_expansion`) after the workspace's clock crossed into
2026-08-25. Reproduced in isolation, unrelated to any file in that plan's diff
(`src/sase/main/query_handler/_embedded_workflows.py`,
`src/sase/axe/run_agent_runner_setup.py`, `src/sase/xprompt/_parsing.py`,
`src/sase/xprompt/_parsing_vcs_tags.py`):

```
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_bead/test_cli_history.py::test_history_full_makes_overwritten_note_revisions_readable -x -v
```

RELATED: sase-sq.7.1.3's PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note also lists this same test node among
8 failures it attributes uniformly to golden-fixture drift from commit 96151bbb4. That
explanation fits the golden-contract tests it bundles it with
(`test_cli_golden.py`, `test_cli_search.py`), but does not fit this test: it has no
golden fixture file and fails on a plain hardcoded date literal, so its remediation
(compute the expected date dynamically, e.g. via a frozen/injected clock, instead of
a hardcoded literal) is different from the golden-fixture-refresh fix that note
proposes.

task_type_fields.impact: Breaks just test-scoped / just test-cost / just check-full for every agent working in this repo starting 2026-08-25, with a misleading assertion failure unrelated to whatever change triggered the run.
